snippet.title: Squarena - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
The smaller you get… the harder it is to survive.

Squarena is a fast-paced 2D arena shooter where damage makes you smaller, faster, and harder to control.

Use physics, abilities, and strategy to outplay your friends in chaotic multiplayer battles.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858400/Squarena/


💥 About the Game

🎮 Chaotic Multiplayer Battles
• Play with up to 6 players in local matches
• Fast-paced combat with unpredictable outcomes

📉 Size-Based Mechanics
• Taking damage makes you smaller
• Smaller size means harder to hit but harder to control

⚙️ Physics-Driven Gameplay
• Every shot impacts your movement
• Use recoil and environment to your advantage

🧠 Skill Meets Strategy
• Easy to learn but hard to master
• Combine shooting, movement, and abilities

🌀 Unique Abilities
• Teleport and shield to outplay opponents
• Deflect bullets and turn them to your color

🗺️ Multiple Game Modes
• Versus, sports modes, and party variations
• Challenge modes and solo experiences

🎯 Extra Features
• Unlockable cosmetics with no microtransactions
• Custom game rules and expanding maps
• Competitive and casual fun for game nights
